cd /workspace && cat > tmp/test_worker_bigB.py <<'PY'
import sys, random, math
sys.path.insert(0,'submission')
from te.worker_solver import solve_worker
exec(open('tmp/test_worker.py').read().split('random.seed(0)')[0])
random.seed(7)
for trial in range(200):
    E=random.randint(1,64); K=random.randint(0,24)
    caps=[random.choice([0,1,2,3,1000]) for _ in range(E)]
    dem=[random.choice([0,1,1000]) for _ in range(K)]
    paths=[]
    for k in range(K):
      m=random.randint(0,8); pp=[]
      for j in range(m):
        pp.append(None if random.random()<.1 else random.sample(range(E),random.randint(1,min(12,E))))
      paths.append(pp)
    owned=sorted(random.sample(range(K),random.randint(0,K)))
    mode=random.choice(['route','admit']);rho=random.choice([1,8]);B=[random.choice([-1e8,-1e6,1e6,1e8]) for _ in range(E)]
    res=solve_worker(caps,dem,paths,owned,mode,rho,B)
    if not check(caps,dem,paths,owned,mode,rho,B,res):
      print('FAIL',trial,mode,rho,E,K);print(caps);print(dem);print(paths);print(owned);print(B);print(res);break
else: print('all bigB ok')
PY
export OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$PWD/native" PYTHONPATH="$PWD/.deps" python3 tmp/test_worker_bigB.py
